    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every card is a focusable button with a visible focus ring; its hint says what Enter and Space do – past cards say they can't move
      - listitem: "Moving by keyboard is announced in a polite live region: what was picked up, each session it's aimed at and whether it has room – or why not – and where it landed"
      - listitem: After a drop, focus moves to the card in its new session; Escape returns it to the card it came from
      - listitem: The week is a grid with day and session heads; Auto / Manual is a radio group you switch with the arrows
      - listitem: The button-like agent logos are toggle buttons named after their agent
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Each card flies from the stack into its first session and shrinks into a chip on the way; the stack closes up behind it
      - listitem: The other pieces of a split task drop into their sessions, the bars at the foot of the sessions fill
      - listitem: A red line with a dot on its left sits between the sessions that are over and the one running
      - listitem: A click on a card opens its details right under it – what it does, the agent, the session and its share; a click elsewhere closes them
      - listitem: Dragging a card – from the stack or between sessions – lifts a copy under the pointer; sessions without room for it – full, out of places or already past – turn gray and striped, the one under it lights up
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion the cards appear in place without flying
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every session keeps its height and takes two cards – sessions with two are full for dragging and for Auto
      - listitem: A long stack scrolls inside its column – it never stretches the board
      - listitem: Under 640px the stack moves on top and the week scrolls sideways
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Give every task a unique id – placing, moving and focus keep track of tasks by it
      - listitem: A task without a usage (NaN) can't be scheduled and says so; a usage of 0 or less counts as 1%
      - listitem: Booked tasks outside the days and sessions shown are left out
      - listitem: usage is a share of one session's limit – e.g. estimated tokens divided by the session's token limit, times 100
      - listitem: Auto never splits a task that fits one session – it waits for a session with room for all of it
      - listitem: "Dragged by hand, a task goes where it's dropped: whatever doesn't fit there runs on into the next sessions with room, after the last one into the earliest free one from now on; pieces are numbered by time and merge within a session"
      - listitem: Tasks that don't fit anywhere this week stay in the stack, marked "No room this week"
      - listitem: Drag a task from the stack into a session to book it by hand – a big one is split from there on; Auto then sorts in only what's left
      - listitem: A press that moves less than 4px is a click (details), anything more is a drag
      - listitem: Holding a card in the stack pauses Auto until it's let go – a click lets Auto carry on
      - listitem: Cards can be grabbed at any time – dragging one while Auto sorts in lets the card in the air land, then stops and switches to Manual; Auto picks up the rest again
      - listitem: With loop, the demo waits while the pointer is over it and stops for good once someone clicks or drags
      - listitem: Cards can be dragged to any session from now on with a free place (two cards at most) and at least minPiece of its limit left; past sessions can't be dragged from or to
      - listitem: planWeek is exported – use it on the server to book the same plan the component shows
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-srn, e.g. --ui-srn-meter or --ui-srn-track
